E1.name: ET-BERT
E1.checkpoint_observation: OFFICIAL_DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE_AFTER_TWO_RESUMED_ATTEMPTS; partial file is not a checkpoint identity
E1.pretraining_corpora: large-scale unlabeled encrypted traffic; official repository discloses CSTNET TLS 1.3 collected March-July 2021
E1.pretraining_collection_dates: CSTNET TLS 1.3: 2021-03 through 2021-07; full checkpoint mixture not completely enumerated
E1.iotsim_overlap_evidence: No IoTSIM name or direct derivative disclosed in official paper/repository; complete pretraining membership is not public
E1.ton_iot_overlap_evidence: No ToN-IoT name or direct derivative disclosed in official paper/repository; complete pretraining membership is not public
E1.required_fields: ordered IP packet bytes and direction/burst boundary

E2.name: YaTC
E2.checkpoint_observation: not downloaded because the official repository has no license grant
E2.pretraining_corpora: official repository lists ISCXVPN2016, ISCXTor2016, USTC-TFC2016 and CICIoT2022 MFR datasets
E2.pretraining_collection_dates: not fully disclosed in official repository
E2.iotsim_overlap_evidence: No IoTSIM name or direct derivative disclosed in official paper/repository
E2.ton_iot_overlap_evidence: No ToN-IoT name or direct derivative disclosed in official paper/repository
E2.native_input_unit: first five packets rendered as a 40x40 MFR byte image

E3.name: netFound-base
E3.checkpoint_observation: complete official model.safetensors; SHA-256 equals official X-Linked-ETag
E3.pretraining_corpora: approximately 10 billion tokens and four billion network flows from University of California Santa Barbara traffic
E3.pretraining_collection_dates: not fully enumerated in the model card/repository
E3.iotsim_overlap_evidence: Official corpus is UCSB traffic and does not disclose IoTSIM or a direct derivative; exact membership audit is unavailable locally
E3.ton_iot_overlap_evidence: Official corpus is UCSB traffic and does not disclose ToN-IoT or a direct derivative; exact membership audit is unavailable locally
E3.native_input_unit: bidirectional flow represented as packet bursts
E3.required_payload: header-derived protocol fields; no payload in the published v2 corpus
E3.required_fields: ordered packet direction, IAT, bytes, packet count, protocol and configured header fields

I1.name: in-domain controlled small self-supervised encoder
I1.pretraining_corpora: only the exact frozen fit-visible packet universe if all D0 gates pass
I1.iotsim_overlap_evidence: exact fit-only source/member/event-position manifest will be hashed; select/report/FINAL are excluded before open
I1.ton_iot_overlap_evidence: exact fit-only source/file/event-position manifest will be hashed; select/report/FINAL are excluded before open
I1.native_input_unit: canonical bidirectional five-tuple session packet-token sequence
I1.required_fields: direction, packet length, protocol and causal IAT bucket inputs
